title: Stable/built-in datasource UIDs must bypass export anonymization
answers: What must be preserved when anonymizing datasources during dashboard export?
Rules for adding new datasource-remapping logic in the v2 exporter
Does anonymization apply to the Dashboard datasource?
body: Any datasource-remapping/anonymization step added to `makeExportableV2` (public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts) must check the query's datasource name against known stable/built-in UIDs (e.g. `SHARED_DASHBOARD_QUERY` = '-- Dashboard --') and skip remapping for them before falling through to instance-specific-UID handling (`isReferencingDsTemplateVariable`, label/uid stripping). Skipping this check causes reimported dashboards to silently resolve the reference to Grafana's built-in datasource, changing panel data.
applies: public/app/features/dashboard-scene/scene/export/exporters.ts makeExportableV2 and any future datasource anonymization added to v2 export
